Interface NotificationManager

All Known Implementing Classes:
NotificationManagerImpl
public interface NotificationManager
Public API for a user's notification inbox. Backs NOTIFICATION_LIST_GET, NOTIFICATION_DETAILS_GET, NOTIFICATION_MARK_READ, NOTIFICATION_DISMISS websocket messages.
